He cuts through the dead like they are nothing, then grabs Dokja by the *throat*.
A message pops up. Junghyeok has become *cautious* of you. Dokja just made the regressor nervous.
Junghyeok asks if he is a regressor too. Dokja says no, but he knows the future Junghyeok *doesn't*.
Dokja thinks he pulled it off, and then Junghyeok stops. One last *question*.
Dokja tells him to let go and get lost, and Junghyeok does. He *lets go*.
He wants one thing. A name. Dokja Kim, comes the answer, and the stranger says what a strange *name*.
Dokja knows this psychopath better than anyone, so he sets terms. I am not your lackey. Treat me as your *equal*.
But the contract forgot the ratio, so Dokja names it. Fifty-fifty? Nope, he takes all the *coins*.
Then a sea serpent rises behind them, and Junghyeok dangles him over the edge. *Prophesy*.
A message says he failed the scenario, and Dokja gasps awake inside the serpent's *stomach*.
On the fourth day, the monster finally *dies*.
